question: The position(s) of how many letters will remain unchanged if all the letters in the word 'ASTEROID' are arranged in English alphabetical order?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b15de16d396b52c68424915920e099dae05b94ac6a08cd00b03ee850fcc8e27.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Given word: 'ASTEROID' 

After arranged in English alphabetical order:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bbb2a7a72319e34df453cd8840ef744be0a5d490b91cd952e4fe0ca77e1995ca.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/593f39b68618a96c00a89630505d883a6b4c080a3147c2f9a437b915f1e05f60.png] 

Thus, the position of **One **letter will remain unchanged if all the letters in the word 'ASTEROID' are arranged in English alphabetical order.

Hence, the correct answer is "One".
